info.title: API.SH: DraftKings
info.description: The DraftKings API from API.SH: public DraftKings data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

get.summary: DraftKings Sportsbook event with all markets
get.description:
One event: teams, start time, status, main lines and every market (popular markets by default, or one category: game lines, player props by type, halves, quarters, team props ...) with all selections and odds. Pass `id` from `/draftkings/v1/odds`, or `league` alone (comma-separated for fallbacks) for the next event. Cached 60 seconds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/draftkings-event

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Event id from /draftkings/v1/odds, or a sportsbook.draftkings.com event link.

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: Instead of id: the next event of the first listed league that has one.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Return at most this many markets.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state whose sportsbook odds to read (default nj): nj, ny, pa, mi, il, oh, az, co, va, in, tn, la, ks, ky, ma, md, nc, ct, ia, nh, wv, wy, vt, me, dc, or on (Ontario).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: DraftKings Sportsbook leagues of a sport
get.description:
Leagues listed for a sport: id, name, short name, whether it is featured and offers same-game parlays. Use the id as `league` in `/draftkings/v1/odds`.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/draftkings-leagues

parameters.name: sport_id
parameters.description: Sport id from /draftkings/v1/sports (3 Football, 2 Basketball, 7 Baseball, 8 Hockey, 1 Soccer, 6 Tennis, 43 MMA).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state whose sportsbook odds to read (default nj): nj, ny, pa, mi, il, oh, az, co, va, in, tn, la, ks, ky, ma, md, nc, ct, ia, nh, wv, wy, vt, me, dc, or on (Ontario).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: DraftKings Sportsbook odds for a league
get.description:
A league's events with teams, start time, status and main lines (moneyline, spread, total), plus every listed market of the league page with all selections (American and decimal odds, fractional, implied probability, line). Pass `category` (and `subcategory`) from `categories[]` / `subcategories[]` for player props, futures, halves, quarters and the rest. Filter by team and date. Cached 60 seconds.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/draftkings-odds

parameters.name: league
parameters.description: nfl, ncaaf, nba, ncaab, wnba, nhl, mlb, epl, champions-league, la-liga, serie-a, bundesliga, ligue-1, mls, ufc, cfl, or any league id from /draftkings/v1/leagues.

parameters.name: category
parameters.description: Category id from categories[] (e.g. player props).

parameters.name: team
parameters.description: Only events whose name contains this text.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Only events starting on this UTC date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: US state whose sportsbook odds to read (default nj): nj, ny, pa, mi, il, oh, az, co, va, in, tn, la, ks, ky, ma, md, nc, ct, ia, nh, wv, wy, vt, me, dc, or on (Ontario).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
